item.title: Special day for lovers in Woodland
item.description: Seven couples got married on Valentine’s Day in the brightly decorated chapel of Yolo County’s Erwin Meier Center.

item.title: Woodland Police Department holds annual awards ceremony
item.description: Cpl. Juan Barrera was named Officer of the Year for his leadership, professionalism, and commitment to the community. Records Specialist Edith Nuno received Employee of the Year for her dedication to supporting records and property and evidence through staffing challenges, exemplifying professionalism, positivity, and a strong work ethic.

item.title: Pioneer and Woodland Christian basketball programs gear up for CIF Sac-Joaquin Section playoff runs
item.description: Pioneer High School and Woodland Christian will be well represented in the 2026 CIF Sac-Joaquin Section playoffs, as both the boys and girls programs have clinched respective playoff berths this past week.

item.title: SF Giants sign outfielder Will Brennan to one-year MLB deal
item.description: Brennan will be a full-go in spring training after undergoing two surgeries last year

item.title: Macklin Celebrini makes Olympic history, nears Sharks record as Canada routs France
item.description: Through preliminary round of Milan Cortina Games, Macklin Celebrini has already made history while nearing a San Jose Sharks record

item.title: Letter to the editor: Community civic engagement the focus of Free Pizza and Movie Night
item.description: The League of Women Voters of Yolo County, Indivisible Yolo, and the American Association of University Women of Davis are partnering with community college volunteers to host a local, live civic event in Woodland at Woodland Community College on Tuesday, Feb. 17 from 5-8 p.m.

item.title: SF Giants’ Ron Washington is back coaching eight months after quadruple bypass
item.description: Ron Washington will serve as Tony Vitello's infield coach

item.title: Warriors star Curry plots return to 3-point contest at All-Star 2027
item.description: Curry, 37, has not participated in the contest since 2021, when he won it in Atlanta

item.title: Seahawks expected to poach 49ers assistant to replace Kubiak as offensive coordinator
item.description: Brian Fleury has been with the 49ers since 2019 and had the added role of run-game coordinator for the 2025 season

item.title: Anthony Edwards claims MVP award, leads Stars to tourney win in an entertaining NBA All-Star Game
item.description: The NBA’s fourth All-Star format in four years matched two teams of Americans against a team representing everywhere else.
